en: O God, be kind to me through the survival of my children,
setting them right for me, and allowing me to enjoy them!
My God, make long their lives for me,
increase their terms,
bring up the smallest for me,
strengthen the weakest for me,
rectify for me their bodies, their religious dedication, and their moral traits,
make them well in their souls, their limbs,

ar: وَفِي كُلِّ مَا عُنِيْتُ بِهِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ،
en: and everything that concerns me of their affair,
and pour out for me and upon my hand their provisions!
Make them pious, fearing, insightful, hearing,
and obedient toward Thee, loving and well-disposed toward Thy friends,
and stubbornly resistant and full of hate toward all Thy enemies! Amen!
O God, through them strengthen my arm,

ar: وَأَقِمْ بِهِمْ أَوَدِيْ، وَكَثِّرْ بِهِمْ عَدَدِي،
en: straighten my burdened back, multiply my number,

ar: وَزَيِّنْ بِهِمْ مَحْضَرِي، وَأَحْييِ بِهِمْ ذِكْرِي،
en: adorn my presence, keep alive my mention,

ar: وَاكْفِنِي بِهِمْ فِي غَيْبَتِي وَأَعِنِّي بِهِمْ عَلَى حَاجَتِي،
en: suffice me when I am away, help me in my needs,

ar: وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لِي مُحِبِّينَ، وَعَلَيَّ حَدِبِينَ مُقْبِلِينَ مُسْتَقِيمِينَ لِيْ،
en: and make them loving toward me, affectionate, approaching, upright,
obedient, never disobedient,

ar: وَلاَ عَاقِّينَ وَلا مُخَالِفِينَ وَلاَ خـاطِئِينَ،
en: disrespectful, opposed, or offenders!
Help me in their upbringing, their education, and my devotion toward them,

ar: وَهَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ مَعَهُمْ أَوْلاداً ذُكُوراً ،
en: give me among them from Thyself male children,

ar: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ خَيْراً لي وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لِي عَوناً عَلَى مَا سَأَلْتُكَ،
en: make that a good for me, and make them a help for me in that which I ask from Thee!
Give me and my progeny refuge from the accursed Satan,
for Thou hast created us, commanded us, and prohibited us, and made us desire

ar: فِي ثَوَابِ ما أَمَرْتَنَا وَرَهَّبْتَنَا عِقَابَهُ،
en: the reward of what Thou hast commanded, and fear its punishment!
Thou assigned to us an enemy who schemes against us,

ar: سَلَّطْتَهُ مِنَّا عَلَى مَا لَمْ تُسَلِّطْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ،
en: gave him an authority over us in a way that Thou didst not give us authority over him
allowed him to dwell in our breasts and let him run in our blood vessels;

ar: لاَ يَغْفُلُ إنْ غَفَلْنَا، وَلاَ يَنْسَى إنْ نَسِينَا،
en: he is not heedless, though we be heedless, he does not forget, though we forget;
he makes us feel secure from Thy punishment and fills us with fear toward other than Thee.
If we are about to commit an indecency, he gives us courage to do so,

ar: وَإنْ هَمَمْنَا بِعَمَل صَالِح ثَبَّطَنَا عَنْهُ،
en: and if we are about to perform a righteous work, he holds us back from it.

ar: يَتَعَرَّضُ لَنَا بِالشَّهَوَاتِ، وَيَنْصِبُ لَنَا بِالشَّبُهَاتِ،
en: He opposes us through passions, and sets up for us doubts.

ar: إنْ وَعَدَنَا كَذَبَنَا وَإنْ مَنَّانا، أَخْلَفَنَا
en: If he promises us, he lies, and if he raises our hopes, he fails to fulfil them.
If Thou dost not turn his trickery away from us, he will misguide us,
and if Thou dost not protect us from his corruption, he will cause us to slip.

ar: أللَّهُمَّ فَاقْهَرْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَنَّا بِسُلْطَانِكَ حَتَّى تَحْبِسَهُ عَنَّا
en: O God, so defeat his authority over us through Thy authority, such that Thou holdest him back from us

ar: بِكَثْرَةِ الدُّعَاءِ لَكَ، فَنُصْبحَ مِنْ كَيْدِهِ فِي الْمَعْصُومِينَ بِكَ.
en: through the frequency of our supplication to Thee and we leave his trickery and rise up among those preserved by Thee from sin!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي كُلَّ سُؤْلِي، وَاقْضِ لِي حَوَائِجِي،
en: O God, grant me my every request, accomplish for me my needs,

ar: وَلاَ تَمْنَعْنِي الإجَابَةَ وَقَدْ ضَمِنْتَهَا لِي،
en: withhold not from me Thy response when Thou hast made Thyself accountable for it to me,

ar: وَلا تَحْجُبْ دُعَائِي عَنْكَ وَقَدْ أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ،
en: veil not my supplication from Thyself, when Thou hast commanded me to make it,
and be kind to me through everything that will set me right

ar: فِيْ دُنْيَايَ وَآخِرَتِي مَا ذَكَرْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَـا نَسِيتُ،
en: in this world and the next, in everything that I remember or forget,

ar: أَوْ أَظْهَـرتُ أَوْ أَخْفَيْتُ، أَوْ أَعْلَنْتُ أَوْ أَسْرَرْتُ،
en: display or conceal, make public or keep secret!

ar: وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي جَمِيعِ ذلِكَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ بِسُؤَالِي إيَّـاكَ،
en: In all of this, place me through my asking Thee among those who set things right,
those who are answered favourably when they request from Thee
and from whom is not withheld when they put their trust in Thee,

ar: الْمُعَوَّدِينَ بِالتَّعَوُّذِ بِكَ، الرَّابِحِينَ فِي التِّجَارَةِ عَلَيْـكَ، الْمُجَارِيْنَ بِعِـزِّكَ،
en: those accustomed to seek refuge in Thee, those who profit through commerce with Thee, those granted sanctuary through Thy might,
those given lawful provision in plenty
from Thy boundless bounty through Thy munificence and generosity,

ar: الْمُعَزِّينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ بِكَ، وَالْمُجَارِينَ مِن الظُّلْمِ بِعَدْلِكَ،
en: those who reach exaltation after abasement through Thee, those granted sanctuary from wrong through Thy justice,

ar: وَالْمُعَافَيْنَ مِنَ الْبَلاءِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَالْمُغْنَيْنَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ بِغِنَاكَ،
en: those released from affliction through Thy mercy, those delivered from need after poverty through Thy riches,

ar: وَالْمَعْصومِينَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَالزَّلَلِ وَالْخَطَأِ بِتَقْوَاكَ،
en: those preserved from sins, slips, and offenses through reverential fear toward Thee,
those successful in goodness, right conduct, and propriety through obeying Thee,
those walled off from sins through Thy power,

ar: التَّـارِكِينَ لِكُلِّ مَعْصِيَتِكَ، السَّاكِنِينَ فِي جِوَارِكَ.
en: the refrainers from every act of disobedience toward Thee, the dwellers in Thy neighbourhood!
O God, give me all of that through Thy bestowal of success
and Thy mercy, grant us refuge from the chastisement of the burning,
and give to all the Muslims, male and female,

ar: وَالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِثْلَ الَّذِي سَأَلْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي
en: and all the faithful, male and female, the like of what I have asked for myself

ar: وَلِوُلْدِي فِي عَاجِلِ الدُّنْيَا وَآجِلِ الآخِرَةِ،
en: and my children, in the immediate of this world and the deferred of the next!
Verily Thou art the Near, the Responder, the All-hearing, the All-knowing,
the Pardoner, the Forgiving, the Clement, the Merciful!

ar: وَآتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ.
en: And "give to us in this world good, and in the next world good, and protect us from the chastisement of the Fire" (2:201)!
